result_text:
Contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart are no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles offline. I did not run tests because no existing tests cover the contributor reports, and I did not commit.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: the tables (All, Recent, bots, teams) now list every contributor in sorted order. The "The list is limited to N items" note is gone.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.
- **`LandscapeContributorsListLimit.java`**: deleted. It was the only place doing the truncation and the note, and nothing else referenced it.

`contributorsListLimit` remains in `LandscapeConfiguration` with its default of 1000, so existing `config.json` files still parse. Nothing reads it anymore, so setting it has no effect on these reports.
